summary: Implements CLI command handling and payload processing for Hermes agent shell hooks.
responsibilities: Registers CLI commands for Hermes hook management including installation and uninstallation.
Parses and validates JSON payloads received from Hermes shell hooks via stdin.
Filters stop events based on session status (interrupted or incomplete sessions).
Dispatches hook telemetry data using the session runtime environment.

symbols.name: hermesStopInputSchema
symbols.summary: Zod schema for validating the structure of Hermes stop hook payloads.

symbols.name: registerHermesHookCommand
symbols.summary: Attaches 'hermes' command group and 'stop' action to the primary CLI interface.

symbols.name: registerHermesHooksCommands
symbols.summary: Registers Hermes-specific agent hook utility commands (install/remove) to the registry.

symbols.name: handleHermesStopHook
symbols.summary: Orchestrates the lifecycle of a stop hook payload, from parsing to telemetry transmission.
